name: malformed
description: A page of endpoints in the shapes the ClearPass schema permits but the documentation does not describe: a row that is a bare string, a null mac_address, a mac_address that is not hex, a profile returned as a string rather than an object, attributes returned as a list, device_insight_tags as a number, and added_at/updated_at as free text and as the 0001-01-01 never-sentinel. Proves each unusable row is skipped with a logged reason while the rest of the page still imports, and that no timestamp reaches parse_time without being shape-checked first -- an unscreened value aborts the whole script, taking every other endpoint with it. The 2099 timestamps prove the future-time clamp: runZero rejects an ImportAsset dated ahead of now and would drop the record entirely.
